_how_to_edit: Paste any YouTube link (or just the 11-character ID) into a video's "link". start is seconds to start at (0 = beginning). mode is "required" (locks that card's quick check until the student opens the video) or "optional". title and note show on the card.

hs-ess1-light/l1.where: Level 1, card 1: Parts of a wave
hs-ess1-light/l1.title: Wave Basics
hs-ess1-light/l1.note: Crest, trough, wavelength, frequency and amplitude, the words you just met.

hs-ess1-light/l2.where: Level 2, card 1: The whole family of light
hs-ess1-light/l2.title: What is the Electromagnetic Spectrum
hs-ess1-light/l2.note: The seven kinds of light, from radio waves to gamma rays.

hs-ess1-light/l3.where: Level 3, card 1: Electrons jump up, then fall back down
hs-ess1-light/l3.title: Bohr Model of the Hydrogen Atom
hs-ess1-light/l3.note: Hydrogen's electron drops between energy levels and the colors of light they give off.

hs-ess1-light/l4.where: Level 4, card 1: A pattern only one element can make
hs-ess1-light/l4.title: Why Some of the Rainbow Is Missing
hs-ess1-light/l4.note: The dark lines in sunlight, and how scientists learned that every element has its own pattern.

hs-ess1-light/l5.where: Level 5, card 2: Redshift: the same trick with light
hs-ess1-light/l5.title: How Do We Know the Universe Is Accelerating?
hs-ess1-light/l5.note: Astronomers use redshift to see how fast galaxies are moving away.

hs-ps1-4/l1.where: Level 1 (Energy and Temperature), card 1: Energy shows up in many forms
hs-ps1-4/l1.title: Forms of Energy
hs-ps1-4/l1.note: The kinds of energy you can see or feel, the first big idea of this level.

hs-ps1-4/l2.where: Level 2 (Atoms, Molecules and Reactions), card 1: Atoms join into molecules
hs-ps1-4/l2.title: What's the Difference between an Atom and a Molecule?
hs-ps1-4/l2.note: Atoms, molecules and the bonds that hold them together.

hs-ps1-4/l3.where: Level 3 (Hot or Cold?), card 1: Draw a boundary
hs-ps1-4/l3.title: Exothermic vs Endothermic Chemical Reactions
hs-ps1-4/l3.note: Reactions that warm their surroundings and reactions that cool them.

hs-ps1-4/l4.where: Level 4 (Breaking Costs, Forming Pays), card 1: Bonds work like magnets
hs-ps1-4/l4.title: Energy & Chemistry
hs-ps1-4/l4.note: Energy stored in chemical bonds, and what happens to it when bonds break and form.

hs-ps1-4/l5.where: Level 5 (Energy Diagrams), card 1: Higher or lower?
hs-ps1-4/l5.title: Endothermic and Exothermic Reactions
hs-ps1-4/l5.note: Energy diagrams for reactions that release or absorb energy. This one goes a little beyond the quest.

hs-ps1-4/l6.where: Level 6 (Tally the Bonds), card 1: Hydrogen burns: the ledger
hs-ps1-4/l6.title: Enthalpy of Reaction
hs-ps1-4/l6.note: Adding up bond energies to find a reaction's energy change. This one goes a little beyond the quest.

hs-ps1-4/l7.where: Level 7 (Explain Both Packs), card 1: Run it backward
hs-ps1-4/l7.title: Enthalpy
hs-ps1-4/l7.note: Uses a hand warmer as its example. This one goes a little beyond the quest.
